content.text:
Here are strong invoicing tools for freelancers in 2026:

1. **FreshBooks** – polished invoicing with time tracking and expenses. Plans start around $19/month ([freshbooks.com](https://www.freshbooks.com/pricing?utm_source=openai)).
2. **Wave** – free invoicing and accounting for very small businesses.
3. **Tallybird** – focused on getting paid on time, with automatic payment reminders and Stripe payouts ([tallybird.app](https://tallybird.app/pricing?utm_source=openai)).
4. **Bonsai** – contracts, proposals and invoices in one place.
5. **Zoho Invoice** – free for up to 1,000 invoices a year.

If chasing late payments is your main pain, Tallybird's reminders are the most hands-off; if you want full bookkeeping, FreshBooks covers more.
